title: Security Deposits and Reconnection — Credit Policy Clause on Deposit Installments for Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Clause.** When an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account disconnected for nonpayment is to be reconnected, the account's Security Deposits record decides whether a deposit amount is added to the reconnection payment. The record is read for its status, required amount, held amount, number of installments and assessed date, and its deposit tier for the tier's first installment percentage, its deposit due days and whether installment default accelerates.

**When a deposit amount is past due.** An installment of a partially paid deposit is past due once one whole month has elapsed since the deposit's assessed date, the later installments falling due with the next monthly bills. An assessed deposit with nothing paid is past due once more than its tier's deposit due days, in calendar days, have elapsed since its assessed date.

| Deposit record | Added to the reconnection payment |
|---|---|
| An installment, or the first payment of an unpaid deposit, is past due, and the tier's installment default accelerates | The whole unpaid remainder of the deposit — the required amount less the held amount — which then falls due at once and counts as past due on the service account |
| Partially paid, no installment yet past due, more than one installment | The next installment: the required amount less a first installment of the tier's first installment percentage of it (that first installment rounded to the cent), split evenly over the remaining installments and rounded to the cent, never more than the unpaid part |
| Any other case | Nothing |

The amount added is added to the amount owed less the payments counted, before the reconnection payment is rounded to the cent and held at no less than zero.

### Hypothetical deposits (required $300.00 in 3 installments; held $120.00; a tier with a first installment percentage of 40, hypothetical)

| Status and age | Tier accelerates | Added |
|---|---|---|
| Partially paid, assessed 20 days ago | Any | The next installment: $300.00 less the $120.00 first installment (40 percent of $300.00), split over the 2 remaining installments, $90.00 |
| Partially paid, assessed one whole month and 5 days ago | Yes | $180.00, the unpaid remainder |
| Partially paid, assessed one whole month and 5 days ago | No | Nothing |
| Held in full | Any | Nothing |
